video.decoding_capability: AI Off: 2CH at 32MP/24MP, 4CH at 16MP, 5CH at 12MP, 8CH at 8MP, 11CH at 6MP, 12CH at 5MP, 16CH at 4MP, 32CH at 1080p, 128CH at D1 (30 fps); AI On: 1CH at 32MP/24MP, 2CH at 16MP/12MP, 4CH at 8MP, 5CH at 6MP, 6CH at 5MP, 8CH at 4MP, 16CH at 1080p, 80CH at D1 (30 fps)

features: Simultaneous mode or spot output mode across HDMI1-4

Analytics by Camera: iMD 128CH (max. 128 targets/s), VCA 128CH (max. 64 targets/s), Face Detection 64CH, Video Metadata 64CH, LumiSearch+ 64CH (LumiSearch-enabled camera required), LPR 128CH (max. 64 targets/s)
Analytics by Recorder: iMD NVR 32CH, VCA NVR 32CH (simultaneous output) or 24CH (spot video output), Face Detection NVR 8CH (simultaneous) or 5CH (spot), Video Metadata NVR 8CH
Face Recognition: face captured by camera 32CH / by NVR 8CH (simultaneous output), 16CH / 5CH (spot output); up to 40 face picture libraries (max. 300,000 pictures)
License Plate Recognition (LPR camera required), 1 block list, 1 allow list, up to 20,000 plates
Video Metadata by NVR from compatible third-party cameras via ONVIF Profile M
LumiCloud Lite included; optional LumiCloud HD Video Unity channel annual subscription
1 x RS-232, 1 x RS-485 serial ports
Clients: LumiCloud, LumiViewer Desktop Client, LumiViewer Mobile App
notes: Datasheet gives power consumption as < 18 W, HDD not included.
Bandwidth values are for AI Off. With AI On the datasheet gives 700 Mbps incoming and 512 Mbps outgoing.
